init.title: Event Recording Settings

data.confirm_camera_removals: I confirm removing these camera profiles

data_description.chunk_seconds: Maximum length of each recording segment; longer windows use multiple segments.
data_description.retention_size_mb: Recordings are pruned when the storage budget is reached.
data_description.min_disk_free_mb: Recording admission fails when free disk space would drop below this floor.
data_description.camera_profiles: Each row is identified by its camera entity; use Add, Edit, and Delete in the list. Source ID and display name are inferred for new cameras; leaving the Frigate token blank keeps the saved token for that same camera. Changing a row's camera entity replaces that profile: the previous camera's token and extra settings are not carried over, and its removal is confirmed on Save.
data_description.confirm_camera_removals: Tick to confirm removing the camera profiles no longer listed above, then Save again. Recordings and journal events are never deleted.

data.go2rtc_password: Password (optional, leave blank to keep saved password)

data_description.go2rtc_base_url: HTTP or HTTPS endpoint of the go2rtc API. The integration does not test or discover it.
data_description.go2rtc_password: The saved password is never shown. Leave blank to keep it, or tick the clear box to remove it.

data_description.max_parallel_resources: Caps how many recordings run at the same time.
data_description.queue_wait_timeout_seconds: How long a queued capture waits before it fails with a timeout.

data_description.enable_auto_association: Groups nearby camera events into incidents. Off by default.
